index.tagline: We don't just build cabinets — we craft spaces you'll love living in.
index.designHeadline1: From concept to detail, tailored for you.
index.designHeadline2: Every space deserves its own character and function.
index.strengthsDescription: Quality should never come at the cost of trust. From material sourcing to transparent pricing, every choice we make is designed to give you peace of mind.
index.usBoxDescription1: We source materials locally whenever possible — familiar origins, reliable supply, and consistent quality that eliminates unnecessary shipping costs.
index.usBoxDescription2: We clearly list costs and specifications with no vague estimates, so you know exactly what every dollar gets you — durable, time-tested craftsmanship.
index.usBoxDescription3: We provide on-site assistance for material selection and build planning, walking you through every decision from start to finish.
index.collectionsBody: Explore our diverse range of cabinet collections, each designed to meet different styles and needs.

about.title: About Us
about.description: Winner Cabinets is dedicated to delivering high-quality cabinet solutions. Our team brings years of industry experience to every project.
about.storyHeadline: Built on a decade of craftsmanship
about.ceoDescription: Eric brings over 20 years of business ownership and management experience. With more than a decade in the cabinet industry, he has a deep passion for woodworking and a strong commitment to every project. Known for his integrity and market insight, he personally oversees custom cabinetry for residential and commercial clients — including kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, closets, bookcases, TV walls, office millwork, reception desks, and more.
about.visionBody: We see design as more than aesthetics — it's a way of living that elevates everyday moments. Our work focuses on simplicity, quality, and thoughtful details that last.
about.missionBody1: To craft cabinetry that balances timeless form with comfort and function. We prioritize sustainable choices, careful craftsmanship, and enduring materials so every piece feels as good as it looks.
about.missionBody2: Contact us to learn more about our process and materials.
about.knowUsBody: From our carefully curated collections to our commitment to sustainability, every aspect of Winner Cabinets reflects our dedication to quality and design. We invite you to explore our offerings and discover how our cabinetry can enhance your living spaces.

collections.galleryBody: A glimpse of the custom cabinet projects we've completed for our clients across the Lower Mainland.
collections.productsBody: From kitchen cabinetry to bathroom vanities, explore our range of custom-built collections.
collections.kitchenDesc: Custom-built kitchen cabinets designed for your layout, style, and workflow.
collections.vanityDesc: Elegant vanity solutions that maximize space and elevate your bathroom.
collections.closetDesc: Smart closet designs with full customization for any room size.
collections.millworkDesc: Built-ins, entertainment units, and bespoke pieces for any space.

hours.hoursBody: We're open seven days a week so you can visit at your convenience. Our team is always on hand to help you find the perfect cabinet solution for your space.

cardA.title: Our Services
cardA.description: We offer full-service custom cabinetry from design to installation. Whether you're renovating or building new, our team delivers tailored solutions for every space and style.

cardB.title: Our Team
cardB.description: Our team of experienced designers, craftsmen, and installers is dedicated to delivering outstanding cabinet solutions. We obsess over the details and hold every project to the highest standard of quality.

cardC.title: Our Commitment
cardC.description: We stand behind every project with hands-on support and a commitment to your satisfaction. From first consultation to final installation, we're with you every step of the way.
